svg.title: Lock In: how the pieces talk
svg.desc: Every evening I tell Claude Code on the VPS what I did; it saves it with the lockin CLI into the lockin schema in Supabase Postgres. Every Monday at 05:00 a systemd timer runs Claude headless to grade the week. iPhone Shortcuts call the lockin-latest Edge Function daily at 01:00 to check yesterday was logged and on Monday at 07:30 to read the weekly review.
svg.text: Lock In · how the pieces talk
I log my day to Claude every evening, Claude grades the week every Monday, and my iPhone reads it back.
